PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; Full ON DELETE CASCADE Durability" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#0f172a;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;align=center;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="20" width="1480" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_jobs" value="&lt;b&gt;ingestion_jobs&lt;/b&gt; (Root Batch Job Table)&lt;hr&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;status&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT NOT NULL (PENDING | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;error_message&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;created_at&lt;/b&gt;: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;extraction_status&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT DEFAULT 'NOT_STARTED' (EXTRACTING | EXTRACTED | ACCEPTED)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;report_locked_at&lt;/b&gt;: DATETIME&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;Orchestrates multi-file batch ingestion &amp; statutory extraction lifecycle&lt;/i&gt;" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="100" width="420" height="200" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_docs" value="&lt;b&gt;job_documents&lt;/b&gt; (Staged Source Documents)&lt;hr&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;job_id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK &amp;rarr; ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;file_path&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT NOT NULL&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;document_index&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER DEFAULT 0&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;INDEX idx_job_docs_job ON job_documents(job_id)&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;Supports 1..N documents per report job (Standalone + Consolidated files)&lt;/i&gt;" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f3ff;strokeColor=#7c3aed;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="380" width="420" height="190" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_chunks" value="&lt;b&gt;document_chunks&lt;/b&gt; (Parsed Text &amp; Vector Embeddings)&lt;hr&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT [Maps 1:1 to FAISS Vector ID]&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;job_id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK &amp;rarr; ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;document_id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER [FK &amp;rarr; job_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;page_num&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER NOT NULL (1-based physical page number)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;chunk_text&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT NOT NULL (1500 chars with 300 char overlap)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;vector_id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER (Legacy alias, aligned with id)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;topic_labels&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT (Optional keyword tags)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;embedding&lt;/b&gt;: BLOB (Raw 384-dim Float32 vector, 1536 bytes)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;embedding_model&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT DEFAULT 'bge-small-en-v1.5'&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;INDEX idx_chunks_job_page ON document_chunks(job_id, page_num)&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;Permits instantaneous FAISS index re-population without re-embedding&lt;/i&gt;" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ecfdf5;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="570" y="100" width="460" height="270" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t_sections" value="&lt;b&gt;report_sections&lt;/b&gt; (Extracted Statutory Disclosures)&lt;hr&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;job_id&lt;/b&gt;: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK &amp;rarr; ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;group_id&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT NOT NULL (e.g., 'section_a_corporate', 'principle_6')&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;data_json&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT NOT NULL (JSON payload of extracted metrics &amp; tables)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;status&lt;/b&gt;: TEXT DEFAULT 'EXTRACTED' (EXTRACTED | ACCEPTED | FAILED)&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;updated_at&lt;/b&gt;: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP&lt;br&gt;+ &lt;b&gt;UNIQUE(job_id, group_id)&lt;/b&gt; [Enforces idempotent updates]&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;INDEX idx_sections_job_group ON report_sections(job_id, group_id)&lt;/i&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;i&gt;Maintains verified review state before final Inja HTML merge&lt;/i&gt;" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="570" y="420" width="460" height="220" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n_db_notes" value="&lt;b&gt;Data Durability &amp; Integrity Principles&lt;/b&gt;&lt;hr&gt;&lt;b&gt;1. Full Cascade Cleanup:&lt;/b&gt; Deleting a job (`DELETE /api/reports?job_id=X`) cleans up all associated documents, chunks, embeddings, and sections.&lt;br&gt;&lt;b&gt;2. Zero-Loss Vector Caching:&lt;/b&gt; Storing embeddings in `document_chunks.embedding` allows FAISS HNSW indexes to be rehydrated in RAM on server startup without calling the embedding model.&lt;br&gt;&lt;b&gt;3. Idempotent Section Updates:&lt;/b&gt; The `UNIQUE(job_id, group_id)` constraint ensures consultants can edit and re-save sections safely.&lt;br&gt;&lt;b&gt;4. Zero-Contamination Retrieval:&lt;/b&gt; All SQL lookups require `WHERE job_id = :id` preventing cross-enterprise data leakage." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1080" y="100" width="440" height="240" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n_db_perf" value="&lt;b&gt;Storage Performance &amp; Hardware Telemetry&lt;/b&gt;&lt;hr&gt;&bull; WAL Mode ensures concurrent read queries do not block background ingestion writes.&lt;br&gt;&bull; Batch chunk inserts use prepared statements inside a single transaction: `BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT`.&lt;br&gt;&bull; Real-time database disk size (DB file + WAL journal) is streamed via `/api/system` and displayed in the QML client." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="1080" y="380" width="440" height="160" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_job_docs" value="1 : N (CASCADE)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="t_jobs" target="t_docs"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_job_chunks" value="1 : N (CASCADE)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#064e3b;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="t_jobs" target="t_chunks"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_doc_chunks" value="1 : N (CASCADE)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#7c3aed;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="t_docs" target="t_chunks"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_job_sections" value="1 : N (CASCADE)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#78350f;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="t_jobs" target="t_sections"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
svg.text: Carbon Engine — SQLite Database Schema & Entity Relationships
Configured with PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; Full ON DELETE CASCADE Durability
+ status: TEXT NOT NULL (PENDING | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED)
Orchestrates multi-file batch ingestion & statutory extraction lifecycle
+ job_id: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK → ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]
Supports 1..N documents per report job (Standalone + Consolidated files)
+ id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT [Maps 1:1 to FAISS Vector ID]
+ job_id: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK → ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]
+ document_id: INTEGER [FK → job_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]
+ page_num: INTEGER NOT NULL (1-based physical page number)
+ chunk_text: TEXT NOT NULL (1500 chars with 300 char overlap)
+ vector_id: INTEGER (Legacy alias, aligned with id)
Permits instantaneous FAISS index re-population without re-embedding
+ job_id: INTEGER NOT NULL [FK → ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE]
+ data_json: TEXT NOT NULL (JSON payload of extracted metrics & tables)
Maintains verified review state before final Inja HTML merge
1. Full Cascade Cleanup: Deleting a job (DELETE /api/reports?job_id=X)
cleans up all associated documents, chunks, embeddings, and sections.
2. Zero-Loss Vector Caching: Storing embeddings in document_chunks.embedding
allows FAISS HNSW indexes to be rehydrated in RAM on server boot.
3. Idempotent Section Updates: UNIQUE(job_id, group_id) ensures
consultants can edit and re-save sections safely.
4. Zero-Contamination Retrieval: All SQL lookups require WHERE job_id = :id
• WAL Mode ensures concurrent read queries do not block background ingestion.
• Batch chunk inserts use prepared statements inside a single transaction:
• Real-time database disk size (DB file + WAL journal) is streamed via
/api/system and displayed in the QML client.
